en: Every cutting tool begins in pieces.
Before it ever cuts, it travels.
Assembled.
Shrunk.
Cooled.
Measured.
Recorded.
Station by station. Hand by hand.
And when the shift ends, the journey stops.
So we put the whole journey into one box.
This is roboBox.
Slide in a pallet, booked straight from your tool management.
A six-axis robot takes it from there.
It heats the holder, and shrinks the cutter in, right to length.
Cools it down,
and measures every tool before it leaves.
Ready for the machine. Data included.
Shrinking, cooling, measuring, clamping, pressing.
Up to six modules, built around your tools.
It doesn't go home when the shift ends.
And you can check on it from anywhere.
At four hundred and eighty tools a day,
it pays for itself in two point three years.
roboBox. Think inside the box.
